# Arthavi (llms.txt)

> Arthavi is a free, privacy-first portfolio tracker for Indian families. It imports CAMS/KFintech CAS statements and broker tradebooks (CSV or Excel) without any broker login, and tracks mutual funds, stocks, SIF, PMS and AIF, NPS, FDs and bonds, gold, real estate, ULIPs and insurance for every family member, with true XIRR, capital gains reports and an AI assistant. For comprehensive documentation, feature benchmarks, competitor analyses, and security architecture, read [llms-full.txt](https://arthavi.com/llms-full.txt).

## Core Documentation & LLM Resources

- [Full LLM Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt)](https://arthavi.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive documentation covering product architecture, competitive matrix, CAS parsing methodology, security specifications, and tool descriptions.
- [Privacy Model](https://arthavi.com/privacy-model/): Detailed breakdown of data collection, encryption, and why Arthavi never reads emails or requires broker passwords.
- [Methodology](https://arthavi.com/methodology/): Technical documentation on CAS parsing pipeline, XIRR calculation (Newton-Raphson), market data sources, and overlap detection algorithm.

## Feature Pages (what each tracker does, how it calculates, limits)

- [NPS Tracker](https://arthavi.com/nps-tracker/): Tier I and II, schemes E, C, G, A, contribution plan, XIRR to the NAV date.
- [PMS & AIF Tracker](https://arthavi.com/pms-aif-tracker/): Capital calls, distributions, statement value, XIRR, yearly STCG/LTCG.
- [ULIP Tracker](https://arthavi.com/ulip-tracker/): Fund units and NAV, premiums paid, paid-up and single-premium policies, XIRR.
- [Insurance Tracker](https://arthavi.com/insurance-tracker/): Term, health, critical illness, motor and ULIP policies; cover totals and premium due dates.
- [Gold Tracker](https://arthavi.com/gold-portfolio-tracker/): Jewellery, coins, SGB and digital gold valued at an estimated Indian market rate.
- [Real Estate Tracker](https://arthavi.com/real-estate-tracker/): Property cost, home loan, appreciation, rental yield and XIRR.
- [Rental Cash Flow Tracker](https://arthavi.com/rental-property-cash-flow-tracker/): Rent and expense ledger, sale simulator, Nifty 50 comparison.
- [Interest Payout Schedule](https://arthavi.com/interest-payout-tracker/): FD, SCSS, MIS, PMVVY, bond and SGB payouts with TDS.
- [Gifted Mutual Fund Units](https://arthavi.com/mutual-fund-gift-tracker/): Recipients keep the donor's original cost and purchase date.
- [Stock Tradebook Import](https://arthavi.com/stock-tradebook-import/): CSV and Excel tradebooks from Zerodha, Groww, Upstox and others.
- [Capital Gains Report](https://arthavi.com/capital-gains-tax-report/): FIFO per folio, July 2024 rates, grandfathering, Schedule 112A CSV.
- [SIP Tracker](https://arthavi.com/sip-tracker/): All family SIPs, next dates, reminders and XIRR.
- [Changelog](https://arthavi.com/changelog/): Dated list of features launched in the app, newest first.
- [Family Portfolio Tracker](https://arthavi.com/family-portfolio-tracker/): Separate profiles per member and a combined family view.
- [Mutual Fund Portfolio Tracker India](https://arthavi.com/mutual-fund-portfolio-tracker-india/): Every folio from a CAMS / KFintech CAS, true XIRR, SIPs and capital gains.
- [Net Worth Tracker India](https://arthavi.com/net-worth-tracker-india/): Family net worth across funds, stocks, EPF, PPF, NPS, FDs, gold and property.

## Alternatives & Comparisons

- [Compare Portfolio Trackers Hub](https://arthavi.com/compare/): Side-by-side benchmark comparing Arthavi against MProfit, INDmoney, Value Research, Dezerv, Kuvera, Zerodha, and Excel.
- [Best MProfit Alternative](https://arthavi.com/alternatives/mprofit/): Free, cloud-based MProfit alternative with honest comparison table on pricing, privacy, import, family support, and AI.
- [Best INDmoney Alternative](https://arthavi.com/alternatives/indmoney/): Privacy-first INDmoney alternative — no email scraping, no data selling, no spam calls.
- [Best Kuvera Alternative](https://arthavi.com/alternatives/kuvera/): Independent Kuvera alternative (Kuvera is part of CRED since 2024) — Arthavi is not owned by any broker or investing platform.
- [Arthavi vs MProfit (Detailed)](https://arthavi.com/alternatives/mprofit/): Detailed breakdown of the modern, free MProfit alternative for Indian retail and family investors.
- [Arthavi vs INDmoney (Detailed)](https://arthavi.com/alternatives/indmoney/): In-depth comparison of INDmoney's email-scraping model vs Arthavi's privacy-first approach.
- [Arthavi vs Value Research Online](https://arthavi.com/arthavi-vs-valueresearch/): Fund research tool vs modern portfolio tracking and AI portfolio doctor.
- [Arthavi vs Dezerv](https://arthavi.com/arthavi-vs-dezerv/): DIY automated portfolio tracking vs high-fee managed wealth advisory.
- [Arthavi vs Zerodha Console](https://arthavi.com/arthavi-vs-zerodha/): Single-broker console vs cross-broker family consolidation.
- [Arthavi vs Groww](https://arthavi.com/arthavi-vs-groww/): Execution broker app vs unbiased portfolio health check.
- [Arthavi vs Excel](https://arthavi.com/arthavi-vs-excel/): Why manual spreadsheets fail for tracking Indian portfolios and how Arthavi automates XIRR.

## Free Tools (No Login Required)

- [XIRR Calculator](https://arthavi.com/tools/xirr-calculator/): Calculate true XIRR for SIPs and mutual funds using Newton-Raphson iteration. Add cash flows, generate SIP series, get annualized return.
- [SIP Return Calculator](https://arthavi.com/tools/sip-return-calculator/): Project SIP wealth with step-up and inflation adjustment. Calculates final corpus for any tenure.
- [Mutual Fund Overlap Checker](https://arthavi.com/tools/mutual-fund-overlap/): Compare two mutual funds and see percentage of shared underlying stocks. Identifies concentration risk.
- [LTCG/STCG Tax Calculator](https://arthavi.com/tools/ltcg-stcg-calculator/): Calculate capital gains tax on equity and debt mutual funds for FY 2025-26. Updated with Budget 2024 rates.
- [All Calculators Hub](https://arthavi.com/calculators/): Complete suite including SIP, SWP, CAGR, XIRR, Lumpsum, EMI, FD, PPF, NPS, HRA, Income Tax, and GST calculators.

- [How to Import CAS from CAMS, KFintech & NSDL](https://arthavi.com/guides/how-to-import-cas-cams-kfintech-nsdl/): Step-by-step instructions for downloading and importing CAS into Arthavi.
- [CAMS CAS Statement Guide](https://arthavi.com/cams-cas-statement-guide/): Request the detailed CAMS CAS, summary vs detailed, password, and what happens after upload.
- [9 Best Online Investment Tracker Tools in India](https://arthavi.com/blog/best-online-investment-tracker-india/): Arthavi, INDmoney, Value Research, Groww, MFCentral, Zerodha Console, Kuvera, ET Money and MProfit compared.
- [Can You Use Zerodha and Groww Together?](https://arthavi.com/blog/track-zerodha-groww-portfolio-together/): Yes; how to track both in one dashboard without broker logins.
